LIBERO evaluation script for ACR-VLA.

Rollout loop:
  1. Load LIBERO env + task suite
  2. Load SmolVLA (frozen) + CRM
  3. For each task, rollout N times:
     a. Reset env
     b. Each step: obs → SmolVLA K=10 samples → CGS on 6D pose → CRM
        → combine refined pose with gripper → execute 7D action
     c. Record success/failure
  4. Report per-task and overall success rate

Baselines:
  - "vla_only": SmolVLA mean of K=10, no CRM refinement
  - "crm_scalar": CRM with scalar uncertainty (single std, not per-DOF)
  - "crm_perdof": CRM with full per-DOF uncertainty (ours)
  - "acr_vla": alias for crm_perdof — the full ACR-VLA pipeline
  - "reconvla": ReconVLA baseline — scalar Euclidean argmin selection (plan_014)
  - "adaptive_k": Adaptive K — K=2 L2 probe, expand to K=10 + CRM obs_only if uncertain

Adaptive K mode (--mode adaptive_k):
  Each step: generate K=2 samples, compute pairwise L2 distance.
  If L2 > threshold (high uncertainty): generate 8 more (total K=10),
    select argmin(L2 to mean), apply CRM obs_only correction (epsilon=0.2).
  If L2 <= threshold (low uncertainty): use mean of K=2, skip CRM.

Usage:
  python evaluate.py --benchmark object --checkpoint /path/to/crm_best.pt --n_rollouts 20
  python evaluate.py --benchmark object --mode vla_only --n_rollouts 20
  python evaluate.py --benchmark spatial --mode reconvla --n_rollouts 20
  python evaluate.py --benchmark spatial --mode acr_vla --crm_checkpoint /path/to/crm_best.pt --n_rollouts 10
"""
import argparse
import functools
builtins_print = print
print = functools.partial(builtins_print, flush=True)
import os
os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE", "1")
import sys
import json
import time
import signal
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np
from robosuite.utils.transform_utils import quat2axisangle

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from cgs import ConformilizedGaussianScoring
from crm import ConformalRefinementModule
from aci import AdaptiveConformalInference
from utils import set_seed, CORRECTION_DIM, FULL_ACTION_DIM, H_EFF, OBS_DIM
from reconvla_baseline import reconvla_select

# Official LIBERO max steps per suite (lerobot convention)
SUITE_MAX_STEPS = {"object": 280, "spatial": 280, "goal": 300, "long": 520, "90": 400}


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate ACR-VLA on LIBERO")
    p.add_argument("--benchmark", type=str, default="object",
                   choices=["object", "spatial", "goal", "long", "90"])
    p.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Path to CRM checkpoint (crm_best.pt)")
    p.add_argument("--crm_checkpoint", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Alias for --checkpoint (used with --mode acr_vla)")
    p.add_argument("--n_rollouts", type=int, default=20)
    p.add_argument("--max_steps", type=int, default=300,
                   help="Max steps per rollout")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p.add_argument("--K", type=int, default=10)
    p.add_argument("--mode", type=str, default="crm_perdof",
                   choices=["vla_only", "crm_scalar", "crm_perdof", "acr_vla", "crm_obs_only", "reconvla", "random_selection", "adaptive_k", "adaptive_unc_head", "adaptive_conformal_crm"])
    p.add_argument("--baseline_mode", type=str, default="single",
                   choices=["single", "mean"],
                   help="vla_only baseline: single (K=1) or mean (K=10 avg)")
    p.add_argument("--smolvla_path", type=str, default="/root/autodl-tmp/models/smolvla_libero/")
    p.add_argument("--model", type=str, default="smolvla",
                   choices=["smolvla", "pi05", "openvla_oft"],
                   help="VLA model backbone")
    p.add_argument("--pi05_path", type=str,
                   default="/root/autodl-tmp/models/pi05_libero_finetuned/",
                   help="Path to Pi0.5 model")
    p.add_argument("--openvla_oft_path", type=str,
                   default="/root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-oft/object/",
                   help="Path to OpenVLA-OFT model")
    p.add_argument("--obs_dim", type=int, default=OBS_DIM)
    p.add_argument("--unified_obs_dim", type=int, default=None,
                   help="Zero-pad obs_features to this dim for unified CRM inference")
    p.add_argument("--hidden_dim", type=int, default=256)
    p.add_argument("--task_filter", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Substring filter on task_name; only matching tasks are evaluated")
    p.add_argument("--render", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--output_file", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Save results JSON to this path")
    p.add_argument('--max_correction_norm', type=float, default=None,
                   help='Override CRM max_correction_norm (default: use checkpoint value)')
    p.add_argument("--adaptive_k", action="store_true",
                   help="Enable adaptive K sampling (start with k_init, expand to k_full if needed)")
    p.add_argument("--adaptive_threshold", type=float, default=0.1,
                   help="L2 distance threshold for adaptive K branching")
    p.add_argument("--k_init", type=int, default=2,
                   help="Initial sample count for adaptive K")
    p.add_argument("--k_full", type=int, default=5,
                   help="Full sample count when adaptive K expands")
    p.add_argument("--unc_head_checkpoint", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Path to trained UncertaintyHead model checkpoint")
    p.add_argument("--unc_threshold", type=float, default=0.5,
                   help="Uncertainty threshold tau: u > tau triggers CRM correction")
    p.add_argument("--conformal_threshold", type=float, default=0.074855,
                   help="Conformal threshold tau for K=2 L2 distance (P50)")
    p.add_argument("--n_action_steps", type=int, default=10,
                   help="Number of action steps to replay from PI05 chunk (default: 10)")
    return p.parse_args()


def get_robot_state(obs):
    """Extract 8D robot state: eef_pos(3) + eef_axisangle(3) + gripper_qpos(2)."""
    eef_pos = obs["robot0_eef_pos"]
    eef_axisangle = quat2axisangle(obs["robot0_eef_quat"])
    gripper_qpos = obs["robot0_gripper_qpos"]
    return np.concatenate([eef_pos, eef_axisangle, gripper_qpos]).astype(np.float64)


def load_libero_env(benchmark_name):
    """Load LIBERO benchmark tasks and create environments."""
    from libero.libero import benchmark as bm
    from libero.libero.envs import OffScreenRenderEnv

    benchmark_dict = {
        "spatial": "libero_spatial",
        "object": "libero_object",
        "goal": "libero_goal",
        "long": "libero_10",
        "90": "libero_90",
    }
    bm_name = benchmark_dict[benchmark_name]
    benchmark_instance = bm.get_benchmark(bm_name)()
    n_tasks = benchmark_instance.n_tasks

    task_envs = []
    for task_idx in range(n_tasks):
        task = benchmark_instance.get_task(task_idx)
        task_name = task.name

import json, sys

found = []
for exp_id, e in exps.items():
    s = json.dumps(e).lower()
    if 'adaptive_conformal' in s and 'spatial' in s and 'tau' in exp_id and '025' in exp_id:
        cmd = e.get('spec', {}).get('command', '') if isinstance(e.get('spec'), dict) else ''
        server = e.get('spec', {}).get('server', '') if isinstance(e.get('spec'), dict) else ''
        seed = e.get('spec', {}).get('seed', '') if isinstance(e.get('spec'), dict) else ''
        log_in_spec = e.get('spec', {}).get('log_path', '') if isinstance(e.get('spec'), dict) else ''
        log_path = e.get('log_path', '')
        sr = e.get('metrics', {}).get('success_rate', '') if isinstance(e.get('metrics'), dict) else ''
        found.append({
            'exp_id': exp_id,
            'seed': seed,
            'server': server,
            'command': cmd,
            'log_path': log_path,
            'log_in_spec': log_in_spec,
            'success_rate': sr,
            'status': e.get('status'),
            'has_K_flag': '--K' in cmd if cmd else 'NO_CMD',
        })

found.sort(key=lambda x: str(x.get('seed', '')))

    print(json.dumps(f, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Six-way comparison table: seed42 + seed43 + pooled, LaTeX tabular output.

Dependencies: numpy
Usage: python comparison_table.py [--json INPUT.json] [--out TABLE.tex] [--dry-run]
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "figures"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

SPATIAL_TASKS = [
    "between_plate_and_ramekin",
    "next_to_ramekin",
    "from_table_center",
    "on_cookie_box",
    "in_top_drawer",
    "on_ramekin",
    "next_to_cookie_box",
    "on_stove",
    "next_to_plate",
    "on_wooden_cabinet",
]

TASK_DISPLAY = {
    "between_plate_and_ramekin": "Betw. Plate \\& Ramekin",
    "next_to_ramekin": "Next to Ramekin",
    "from_table_center": "Table Center",
    "on_cookie_box": "On Cookie Box",
    "in_top_drawer": "In Top Drawer",
    "on_ramekin": "On Ramekin",
    "next_to_cookie_box": "Next to Cookie Box",
    "on_stove": "On Stove",
    "next_to_plate": "Next to Plate",
    "on_wooden_cabinet": "On Wooden Cabinet",
}

TRIALS_PER_TASK = 10

# Six methods for comparison
METHODS = [
    "vla_only",
    "vla_mean",
    "argmin",
    "acr_scalar",
    "acr_perdof",
    "acr_obs_only",
]

METHOD_DISPLAY = {
    "vla_only":     "VLA-only (K=1)",
    "vla_mean":     "VLA-mean (K=10)",
    "argmin":       "Argmin (K=10)",
    "acr_scalar":   "ACR scalar",
    "acr_perdof":   "ACR per-DOF",
    "acr_obs_only": "ACR obs-only",
}

# ── placeholder data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Format: {method: {task: SR_0_to_1}}
# Fill these or pass --json
SEED42_DATA = {m: {t: None for t in SPATIAL_TASKS} for m in METHODS}
SEED43_DATA = {m: {t: None for t in SPATIAL_TASKS} for m in METHODS}


def load_data(json_path=None):
    if json_path:
        with open(json_path) as f:
            raw = json.load(f)
        return raw["seed42"], raw["seed43"]
    return SEED42_DATA, SEED43_DATA


def compute_overall_sr(data, method):
    """Compute overall SR for a method from per-task data."""
    vals = [data[method][t] for t in SPATIAL_TASKS if data[method].get(t) is not None]
    if not vals:
        return None
    return np.mean(vals) * 100


def compute_pooled_sr(s42, s43, method):
    """Pool two seeds: average the per-task SRs across seeds, then average across tasks."""
    task_srs = []
    for t in SPATIAL_TASKS:
        sr42 = s42[method].get(t)
        sr43 = s43[method].get(t)
        seed_srs = [s for s in [sr42, sr43] if s is not None]
        if seed_srs:
            task_srs.append(np.mean(seed_srs))
    if not task_srs:
        return None
    return np.mean(task_srs) * 100


def fmt_sr(sr):
    if sr is None:
        return "—"
    return f"{sr:.1f}"


def fmt_sr_bold_best(sr, is_best):
    s = fmt_sr(sr)
    if is_best and s != "—":
        return f"\\textbf{{{s}}}"
    return s


def generate_overall_table(s42, s43):
    """Generate the overall SR comparison table (3 columns: seed42, seed43, pooled)."""
    lines = []
    lines.append("\\begin{tabular}{l ccc}")
    lines.append("\\toprule")
    lines.append("Method & Seed 42 & Seed 43 & Pooled \\\\")
    lines.append("\\midrule")

    pooled_srs = {}
    for m in METHODS:
        pooled_srs[m] = compute_pooled_sr(s42, s43, m)

    valid_pooled = [v for v in pooled_srs.values() if v is not None]
    best_pooled = max(valid_pooled) if valid_pooled else None

    for m in METHODS:
        sr42 = compute_overall_sr(s42, m)
        sr43 = compute_overall_sr(s43, m)
        pooled = pooled_srs[m]
        is_best = (pooled is not None and pooled == best_pooled)
        lines.append(
            f"{METHOD_DISPLAY[m]} & {fmt_sr(sr42)} & {fmt_sr(sr43)} & "
            f"{fmt_sr_bold_best(pooled, is_best)} \\\\"
        )

    lines.append("\\bottomrule")
    lines.append("\\end{tabular}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def generate_pertask_table(s42, s43):
    """Generate per-task breakdown for the best two methods (obs_only vs argmin)."""
    m_a, m_b = "acr_obs_only", "argmin"

    lines = []
    lines.append("\\begin{tabular}{l cc cc cc}")
    lines.append("\\toprule")
    lines.append(f" & \\multicolumn{{2}}{{c}}{{Seed 42}} & \\multicolumn{{2}}{{c}}{{Seed 43}} & \\multicolumn{{2}}{{c}}{{Pooled}} \\\\")
    lines.append(f"\\cmidrule(lr){{2-3}} \\cmidrule(lr){{4-5}} \\cmidrule(lr){{6-7}}")
    lines.append(f"Task & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_a]} & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_b]} & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_a]} & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_b]} & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_a]} & {METHOD_DISPLAY[m_b]} \\\\")
    lines.append("\\midrule")

    for t in SPATIAL_TASKS:
        sr42_a = s42[m_a].get(t)
        sr42_b = s42[m_b].get(t)
        sr43_a = s43[m_a].get(t)
        sr43_b = s43[m_b].get(t)

        pool_a_vals = [s for s in [sr42_a, sr43_a] if s is not None]
        pool_b_vals = [s for s in [sr42_b, sr43_b] if s is not None]
        pool_a = np.mean(pool_a_vals) * 100 if pool_a_vals else None
        pool_b = np.mean(pool_b_vals) * 100 if pool_b_vals else None

        def pct(v):
            return f"{v*100:.0f}" if v is not None else "—"

        lines.append(
            f"{TASK_DISPLAY[t]} & {pct(sr42_a)} & {pct(sr42_b)} & "
            f"{pct(sr43_a)} & {pct(sr43_b)} & {fmt_sr(pool_a)} & {fmt_sr(pool_b)} \\\\"
        )

    # Overall row
    lines.append("\\midrule")
    sr42_a_all = compute_overall_sr(s42, m_a)
    sr42_b_all = compute_overall_sr(s42, m_b)
    sr43_a_all = compute_overall_sr(s43, m_a)
    sr43_b_all = compute_overall_sr(s43, m_b)
    pool_a_all = compute_pooled_sr(s42, s43, m_a)
    pool_b_all = compute_pooled_sr(s42, s43, m_b)
    lines.append(
        f"\\textbf{{Overall}} & {fmt_sr(sr42_a_all)} & {fmt_sr(sr42_b_all)} & "
        f"{fmt_sr(sr43_a_all)} & {fmt_sr(sr43_b_all)} & "
        f"\\textbf{{{fmt_sr(pool_a_all)}}} & {fmt_sr(pool_b_all)} \\\\"
    )

    lines.append("\\bottomrule")
    lines.append("\\end{tabular}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Six-way comparison table (LaTeX)")
    parser.add_argument("--json", type=str, default=None, help="JSON data file")
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=str, default=None, help="Output .tex file")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.dry_run:
        print("dry-run OK: all imports successful")
        return

    s42, s43 = load_data(args.json)

    overall = generate_overall_table(s42, s43)
    pertask = generate_pertask_table(s42, s43)

    out_path = args.out or str(OUT_DIR / "comparison_table.tex")

    output = (
        "% Auto-generated by comparison_table.py\n"
        "% Overall SR comparison (6 methods × 3 columns)\n"
        f"{overall}\n\n"
        "% Per-task breakdown (obs_only vs argmin)\n"
        f"{pertask}\n"
    )

    Path(out_path).write_text(output)
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}")
    print("\n% ── Overall table preview ──")
    print(overall)
    print("\n% ── Per-task table preview ──")
    print(pertask)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
